title: Totaligent, Inc. 8-K Filing — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement
summary: Totaligent, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 15, 2026 announcing entry into a Definitive Agreement dated April 10, 2026 for the strategic acqui-hire of Aetherium Medical's team and assets, including the appointment of Ivan Klarich as President and a new board member. The company will form a new subsidiary (Aetherium Medical LLC) and issue milestone-based equity (Series D Preferred Stock convertible into 1,000 shares) to Klarich upon achievement of specified performance targets.
key_points: Totaligent, Inc. entered a Definitive Agreement on April 10, 2026 with Ivan Klarich for the acqui-hire of Aetherium Medical assets (trade secrets, know-how, business relationships)
A new wholly-owned Delaware LLC subsidiary named Aetherium Medical LLC will be formed to receive the contributed assets
Ivan Klarich appointed President immediately upon execution, with board appointment to follow at Closing
Equity compensation: Series D Preferred Stock convertible to 1,000 shares, with initial 10% fully-diluted issuance at Closing plus milestone-based additional percentages
Closing scheduled 30 days after Effective Date, subject to employment agreement execution and salary reduction agreements from existing officers/consultants
Transaction includes provisions for potential joint venture with GloMed Solutions LLC, though this is not a closing condition
why_it_matters: This is a micro-cap medtech corporate transaction with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. The filing is for informational purposes for shareholders of Totaligent, Inc. and does not constitute a market-moving event.
important_numbers: 1,000 shares (Series D Preferred Stock conversion amount)
